cascades_or_tumbles.how_it_works: xBomb removes all symbols except Scatters, Dead Wilds, Resurrection Wilds; +1 win mult; adds one row after explosion (up to 7); new symbols fall in.

base_game_loop.summary: 6-wide expanding grid. Goblin Sacrifice and Dead/Resurrection Wilds build wilds; xBomb clears (sparing scatters/dead/res wilds), +1 mult, +1 row to 7. Evil 4 when all top goblins matched. Fresh Meat 8 FS (Dead Wilds each spin) upgrades to Goblins Feast via Evil 4. Buy 60–666×.

## Resurrection Wilds
You need 3 Dead Wilds to activate and transform them into
Resurrection Wild Symbols. The last Wild symbol to land will also
count as a hefty multiplier.

## Goblin Sacrifice
Match the goblin on top of the reels with the symbol on the reel
beneath that same goblin to trigger a Goblin Sacrifice. get a match
for a grenade to be thrown as a sacrifice, turning him into a Wild
symbol.

## xBomb
The inevitable explosion removes all symbols except Scatter
symbols, Dead Wilds and Resurrection Wilds whilst also increasing
the win multiplier with +1. Every time an xBomb symbol appears,
one row will be added after the explosion, can go up to 7 rows.

## Evil 4
Evil 4 feature is triggered when all goblins at the top of the reels
are matched. The throned goblin will be sitting on reel 1, where
a multiplier of x4 or higher is boosted. The symbols are counted
as 4 of each, multipliers will increase by 1 each time a matching
goblin appears on the top reel.
